items.section: DIRECT2D: a different Windows delivery stack
items.text: The DIRECT2D renderer constructor throws NotSupportedException for any requested depth format other than DepthFormat::None, but GraphicsDeviceManager passes its PreferredDepthStencilFormat (default Depth24) unchanged into the create arguments; no pre-construction normalisation for this family was found, and the family's own example tests construct through a default GraphicsDeviceManager.

items.section: DIRECT2D: a different Windows delivery stack
items.text: DIRECT2D rejects BlendState::Additive (SourceAlpha/One) and One/One with NotSupportedException, asymmetric or non-Add blend states with runtime_error, and reports AdditiveBlending false.

items.section: DIRECT2D: a different Windows delivery stack
items.text: Under Wine/Proton the Direct2D ColorMatrix effect is unavailable and bounded-copy/Porter-Duff composite modes are ignored, so the parity test skips those matrices there; a RenderTarget2D SpriteBatch source that needs tint or NonPremultiplied conversion throws NotSupportedException when the effects are missing.

The Direct2D release gate is blocked: docs/direct2d-native-evidence.md and docs/direct2d-physical-presentation-evidence.md do not exist, and the only native workflow (d3d-windows-ci.yml) is manual dispatch.

items.section: Why shared code does not make the identities equivalent
items.text: No GDI CTest is registered on a cross-build (if(NOT CMAKE_CROSSCOMPILING)) and gdi-windows-ci.yml is manual dispatch on a hosted hidden-window runner, so GDI has no automatic execution and no recorded visible-DPI inspection.

items.section: One blocked sampler decision, and one resource gap that later closed
items.text: SDL_RENDERER does not honour TextureAddressMode Wrap or Mirror for SpriteBatch: the SDL_RenderTexture path clamps, SetSamplerAddressMode is not overridden, and the design decision is recorded as open; a Wrap draw silently shows clamp pixels.

SDL_RENDERER installs the scissor clip for any non-empty ScissorRectangle even when RasterizerState.ScissorTestEnable is false (no ApplyRasterizerState override); the rasteriser construction test cannot detect it.

items.section: Recorded SDL Renderer audit and later repairs
items.text: The SdlRenderer constructor maps any positive swap interval to 1 (SDL_SetRenderVSync(renderer, swapInterval > 0 ? 1 : 0)) while SetSwapInterval forwards 2, so a GraphicsDevice constructed with PresentInterval::Two runs at interval 1 until the next reset.
SDL_RENDERER has no SetViewport override (a custom Viewport never offsets sprites) and echoes requested back-buffer and depth formats it does not have.
items.evidence: SdlRenderer.hpp (no SetViewport, no GetApplied*FormatEXT override); SdlRenderer.cpp (CreateGraphicsRenderer arguments)

items.text: The registered SDL_Renderer_ClearOptions_Audit expects ClearOptions::Stencil alone and Target|Stencil not to throw, but GraphicsDevice::Clear throws InvalidOperationException for an unavailable stencil aspect since the change that rejects unavailable clear attachments; the test's stencil expectations appear stale.
No workflow runs the roughly eighty SDL_Renderer_* family CTests, and they are not registered on Windows (the renderer's default host) or Emscripten.
items.evidence: modules/renderers/sdl-renderer/examples/CMakeLists.txt (NOT EMSCRIPTEN AND NOT WIN32 guard); .github/workflows/input-ci.yml; apple-ci.yml

items.section: Built tests are not registered tests
items.text: CANVAS has no automated browser run: its test programs are built but not registered, and CanvasHostContracts is behind the off-by-default CNA_BUILD_CANVAS_HOST_TESTS with no workflow.

SVG_DOM's smoke, pixel and scissor-order pages run only through the manual run-svgdom-browser-test.sh, and SvgDomHostContracts is behind the off-by-default CNA_BUILD_SVG_DOM_HOST_TESTS with no workflow; HtmlDomHostContracts is likewise opt-in and not run by htmldom-ci.yml.

items.section: HTML_DOM: sprites as pooled CSS objects
items.text: On browsers without mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter, HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM render BlendState::Additive as ordinary composition without an error; only the memoised AdditiveBlending capability reveals it.

items.section: HTML_DOM: sprites as pooled CSS objects
items.text: HTML_DOM and SVG_DOM refuse back-buffer readback; with a bound target smaller than the presentation size, a larger readback region returns transparent padding instead of throwing (source records it as an accepted gap).

items.section: A query result that is not an occlusion measurement
items.text: HEADLESS answers OcclusionQuery true while its query always reports one visible pixel.
The reported SOFTWARE overclaim of MRT and occlusion queries through a default-true branch: both are implemented and answered explicitly (up to four targets; exact surviving-sample counts).
